name: mirage
text: Sharp-book veto: it is logical. Bets a sharp book says are not +EV have done worse on the data (closing-line value -1.8% over 34 games and -0.7%; results -7% and -2%), and our own research found a bet keeps about half of the sharp book's edge, not the average's. So I'm hiding them from the Feed and CNO list entirely, like the hand block, and will release. Your live question is next.
